paragraphs.text: Ophelia was a human from Kenlefia in Jamuraa , who survived a journey to Vacar Slab .

The people of Kenlefia only mete justice on Vacar Slab , a place in the middle of the desert. Despite her misgivings, Ophelia joined her brother in escorting a prisoner they called the Abuser there, along with eight others. The journey was perilous, and the party members started dying sequentially. Two were ambushed by Aerathi berserkers and killed. A poisonous viper bit another, and their water-bearer Teeth fell off a cliff with most of their water. Then D'Bray , their flagbearer died of thirst, and Cleatin , their Gray Ogre protector was killed by a Duneclaw. Then Ophelia's brother Methos too died of thirst, leaving Ophelia to travel with the Akron Legionnaire Spirokai who feels no pain. Together, they brought the Abuser the rest of the way, but they were caught in a Sandstorm , during which Ophelia freed the Abuser and tried to escape. Spirokai caught them though, and buried the Abuser up to the neck. He was about to do the same to Ophelia for betraying him when suddenly a zombified Teeth showed up and slashed Spirokai in the head with his sword. A curse of undeath struck Teeth, and to end it, he wrapped himself up in the last of their bandages, becoming a mummy . Before dying, the Abuser told Ophelia his name was Markus . Ophelia, now alone but carrying both a weapon and water, left Vacar Slab alone. But behind her, Spirokai had survived both his head wound and being buried alive, and started to claw his way out.
